name: Okinawa Financial Group Inc
summary: Okinawa Financial Group, Inc. functions as a diversified provider of financial services. Its extensive portfolio includes conventional banking, general leasing, credit card offerings, securities trading, guarantees, agency operations, and debt collection and management. Furthermore, the company extends its services to encompass financial and economic research, business management consulting, support for developing sales channels, and various computer-related services. Founded in 1956, the company's main office is situated in Naha, Japan.
